min_standing_note.value: Must be in 2nd year of MBA/PGP (having completed foundation courses) or 5th year of a 5-year integrated degree; undergraduate and 1st-year graduate students are ineligible.
min_standing_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: English proficiency certificate or endorsement letter from home university required; no standardized test score minimum or RHET 1020 mention specified.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Term V (Fall): Teaching Aug 31-Nov 21, 2026; mid-terms Oct 5-10, 2026; end-terms Nov 23-28, 2026.
fall_term_dates.notes: 2020-2021 Fact Sheet confirms Term V spans Aug-Nov.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory worldwide health insurance covering at least INR 200,000 (~USD 3,500) valid in India for the duration of stay.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx
housing_availability.notes: On-campus hostel accommodation subject to availability; otherwise OIA provides contact info for nearby off-campus serviced apartments/hotels (confirmed on https://www.iimb.ac.in/about-institute/life-iimb/accommodation).

housing_notes.value: On-campus hostel (subject to availability): INR 20,000/term + veg mess INR 25,000/month (+ INR 4,000 non-veg). Off-campus alternatives: serviced apartments ~INR 20,000/month (excl. food) or nearby hotels INR 1,600-3,500/day (per 2020-2021 fact sheet; current page https://www.iimb.ac.in/about-institute/life-iimb/accommodation).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

citizenship_restrictions.value: Exchange program at IIMB is not open to students holding an Indian passport.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Student Visa only required (no tourist visa); IIMB provides admission letter for visa application but does not issue financial guarantees. Lead time not specified.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

credit_system_and_load.value: Most courses carry 3 credits (some 1.5 credits); 1 credit = 10 classroom contact hours. Required credit workload is determined by the student's home institution.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

course_restrictions_note.value: Restricted to Term V graduate PGP/MBA elective courses (open to 2nd-year MBA/PGP or 5th-year integrated students who completed foundation coursework; mandatory 80% attendance per course per iimb.ac.in).
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

academic_style.value: Rigorous postgraduate management curriculum with mandatory minimum 80% attendance per course and mid-term plus end-term examinations.

international_support_services.value: ATHITHI weekend host-family program with IIMB alumni families; Office of International Affairs (OIA) pre-arrival accommodation and ERP onboarding support.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B)/Indian Instit. Manag-Bangalore.docx

nomination_deadlines.value: Term V nomination deadline Apr 1 (2026-2027 cycle).
nomination_deadlines.notes: Student application deadline after Apr 1 nomination not separately published on public page.
